description: The control of nested-priority-witness, with y → B z in place of y → B z [U]. The second witness, where [A] reads A, now omits no optional that it can read as written, so it is eligible, and begins of r holds (engine §4).
grammar:
%elidable T U
%rule text A B C T U
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r [A] y [T] C T U
%rule y A B | A B C | B z
%rule z ε | C T
